Package de.ikor.sip.foundation.core.declarative.orchestration.connector

Interface ConnectorOrchestrationInfo

All Superinterfaces:
OrchestrationInfo
public interface ConnectorOrchestrationInfo extends OrchestrationInfo
Class that provides the RouteDefinition handles for a connector to define its necessary orchestrations.

The orchestrations done by the connector are typically (but not limited to):

  • (Un-)marshalling the domain model used by the orchestrator from/to the message send to the external system.
  • Mapping between the connectors own and it's associated integration scenario's request and response models.
The provided RouteDefinition also allows for more complex orchestration scenarios with Camel's EIP implementations (e.g. enrich, split, etc.).

    • getRequestRouteDefinition

      org.apache.camel.model.RouteDefinition getRequestRouteDefinition()
      RouteDefinition for the request route of the connector (i.e. before communication with the outbound system(s)).

      Will typically contain at least the transformation from the connector's to the integration scenario's request model.

      Returns:
      RouteDefiniton handle for the request route within the connector

    • getResponseRouteDefinition

      Optional<org.apache.camel.model.RouteDefinition> getResponseRouteDefinition()
      RouteDefinition for the response route of the connector (i.e. after receiving the response from the outbound system(s)).

      Will typically contain at least the transformation from the integration scenario's to the connector's response model.

      Returns:
      RouteDefiniton handle for the response route within the connector. Empty if the connector or integration scenario does not have a response flow.
